acceptance.requirement: Initial Connected Cozy participation is invitation-only with no public stranger matchmaking.
Every participant retains independent identity, authorization, visibility and delegation; group authority is never pooled.
Host/admin cannot spend, consent, choose or speak canonically for another human participant.
Solo Cozy sharing creates/binds an explicit governed shared orchestration identity without silently converting Personal source state into shared ownership.
Invite/accept/decline/leave/revoke/rejoin have explicit versioned membership states and fresh authorization on rejoin.
Shared activity families are bounded to owning-domain-safe operations; GM/human-required and unsupported operations stop.
Scarce resource contribution uses owning-domain reserve/commit/release semantics and prevents double spend.
Every contribution has stable identity/idempotency, participant/controller attribution, expected versions and durable outcome state.
Async contributions and live co-op windows use the same authoritative state/version/order contracts.
Concurrent/racing contributions produce explicit stale/re-evaluate behavior, never silent last-write-wins.
Human-required social, advancement, sharing and delegation choices cannot be filled by host, AI, majority vote or inactivity.
Shared controller operations remain APM-01 bounded and require current per-operation authorization/delegation.
APW-06 authorization/visibility filtering precedes participant counts, badges, notifications, deep links and optional-AI context.
Group AI/presentation context cannot combine participant-private material unless every source is explicitly shared/authorized.
Leave/revoke removes future authority and releases uncommitted reservations without erasing committed attributable history.
Host disconnect/inactivity never transfers host authority automatically.
Leaving Connected Cozy preserves independent Personal work and never copies protected shared/Campaign truth implicitly.
Connected Cozy remains fully usable with deterministic rules/prompts/summaries and no AI provider.
APM-05 preserves reusable multi-participant infrastructure but does not authorize multiplayer AutoGM direction.
Invitation, contribution, waiting, leave and recovery flows have mobile, keyboard, screen-reader/nonvisual and reduced-motion parity.
Shared-play language is welcoming and low-pressure without social guilt, streak pressure or fake urgency.
No implementation, migration, public matchmaking, AI mechanical/canonical authority, release/deployment or T04 authority is granted.
